rows.text: The release states that 'The Interim Speaker of the Legislative Assembly, Lord Tangi 'o Vaonukonuka has issued a notice for a meeting of the Elected Representatives to be convened on Monday 15 December 2025, at 10:00am', and that 'The election of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Legislative Assembly will be held at the same meeting, following the announcement of the elected Prime Minister Designate'.
rows.uncertainty: A prospective notice naming no Speaker: it schedules the Speaker's election but does not record it. No record of the sitting itself was found, so the day of the election is not inferred from this notice.
